title: The Man Who Drove the School Bus
style: cinematic live-action film still, 35mm, shallow depth of field, moody teal and orange grade, realistic skin, vertical 9:16

daniel.look: Daniel, a tall broad-shouldered man in his late 30s, short dark hair, light stubble, tired kind eyes, worn grey work jacket

mia.look: Mia, a 7-year-old girl with curly brown hair and a yellow raincoat

boss.look: Rocco, a heavy-set man in his 40s in a black leather coat with a scar over his left eyebrow

scenes.image: [[daniel]] driving a yellow school bus at dawn, children laughing behind him, warm sunrise through the windshield
scenes.motion: slow push-in on his calm face, soft light flicker
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Everyone in town thought Daniel was just the quiet school bus driver.

scenes.image: [[mia]] runs and hugs [[daniel]] outside a small rented house, golden evening light
scenes.motion: she runs into his arms, camera tracks gently
scenes.speaker: mia
scenes.line: Daddy, you promised we would never move again!

scenes.image: Close-up of [[daniel]] smiling softly while hiding a faded military tattoo under his sleeve
scenes.motion: he pulls his sleeve down slowly
scenes.speaker: daniel
scenes.line: I promise, sweetheart. This is home.

scenes.image: Three black SUVs stop outside the house at night, headlights cutting through rain, [[boss]] stepping out
scenes.motion: headlights sweep across wet street, rain falling
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: But at night, the past always finds a way home.

scenes.image: [[boss]] holding a bat and smiling coldly at [[daniel]] on the porch, six armed men behind him
scenes.speaker: boss
scenes.line: Pay what your landlord owes me, or we burn this place down.

scenes.image: [[daniel]] gently pushes [[mia]] behind the door, his eyes turning cold and focused, rain dripping from his jacket
scenes.speaker: daniel
scenes.line: Mia, close your eyes and count to ten.

scenes.image: Silhouette of [[daniel]] stepping off the porch into the rain facing six men, dramatic backlight
scenes.motion: he walks forward, men step back
scenes.speaker: daniel
scenes.line: You came to the wrong house.

scenes.image: Extreme close-up of [[boss]] frightened as a scarred hand grabs the bat from him, blurred fight in background
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Rocco did not know he had just woken up a ghost the army once feared. Part two... tomorrow.

caption: He only wanted a quiet life... #drama #shortfilm #story
